title: Agency
description: A transit operating organization. Reused from GTFS agency.txt, aligned with Transmodel Operator.

shortCode.description: Lowercase short code used in all other ids (e.g. 'lbt').

name.description: Public display name of the agency.

gtfsAgencyId.description: Agency id as it appears in the agency's published GTFS feed (may differ from shortCode).

defaultLocale.description: BCP 47 locale (e.g. en-US). Default for radio prompts and notifications.

rulebookRef.description: Reference to the agency's Rule set in this ontology. Opaque to the schema; by convention a rule-id prefix.
